The '''Tibrin system''', also known as the '''Cal system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]] and the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Cal (star)|Cal]].
